countdown.description: Whether the timer should countdown, decrementing the timer on each tick.

start-ms.description: The total duration of the timer in milliseconds.

target-ms.description: The minimum count of the timer in milliseconds.

auto-start.description: Whether the timer should start automatically

interval.description: The interval in milliseconds to update the timer count.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

complete.description: Fired when the timer is completed

ids.description: The ids of the timer parts

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
